answer: Identity issuance uses a sybil-scoring oracle. Each applicant proves control of a scarce resource - a tax identity or a hardware key minted once - logged publicly. The oracle scores graph overlap: if its payments or endorsements touch an existing cluster, the new bond multiplies by overlap depth. A falcon-fast farm of hundreds of wallets then posts exponentially more collateral than it earns, and staked validators slash fraudulent bonds. An honest deposit stays a walnut beside that mountain; unlike a lotus of many petals from one root, pseudonyms trace to one operator and are priced as one.
